sources.supports: Google's current pricing page lists standard Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite context caching at $0.01 per million text, image, or video tokens. It does not establish the earlier rate or when the listed rate took effect.

notes: The available official pricing page shows $0.01 now, but no primary source found here establishes whether $0.025 was ever Google's official rate or dates a reduction. Internet Archive's CDX endpoint timed out from this environment, so no before-and-after snapshots were obtained.
